name: Bernd Lange-Article 19, après le § 1 (correspond à l'article 22 dans l'amendement 120)-Am 124
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on applying a generalised scheme of tariff preferences and repealing Regulation (EU) No 978/2012 of the European Parliament and of the Council
part_text: 1 a. The Generalised Scheme of Preferences (GSP) shall not condition trade preferences for beneficiary countries on their migration and readmission cooperation with the Union. Such linkage is unrelated to the GSP’s objectives of promoting sustainable development and respect for human rights and risks undermining the scheme’s coherence and credibility. Moreover, migration-related conditionality is incompatible with the rules of the World Trade Organization, as it falls outside the permissible criteria for differentiated treatment under international trade law.
